newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Spain's Repsol to invest $2 bln in Argentina - Telam.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Repsol to invest $2 bln in Argentina - Telam.

text.p: Spanish oil company Repsol SA will invest $2 billion in Argentina over the next four years, its president Alfonso Cortina said Wednesday, according to state news agency Telam.
"Through (affiliate oil firm) Astra Argentina we will move either directly or indirectly $2 billion by the end of the century," he told President Carlos Menem, according to state news agency Telam.
In June Repsol bought a controlling 37.7 percent stake of Astra for $360 million.
"I expressed to President Menem...our determination to keep investing in Argentina, which will lead to the creation of new jobs," Cortina said.
He added Repsol's investments could be even "much higher" than the $2 billion announced.
In 1995 Astra posted net profit of $46 milllion.
